entries.zh: 困气；困倦欲睡、昏昏欲睡（西语谓“倦极而睡，行将睡去”）
entries.en: sleepy; drowsy from weariness, nodding off as one goes

entries.zh: 行房；夫妻交合、同房（西语谓“丈夫与妻子同睡”，即指行房）
entries.en: (of husband and wife) to sleep together; marital intercourse

entries.zh: 直挺挺地睡死；伸展手脚僵卧酣睡（西语词头缩损，推定为 dormir derecho“直身而睡”）
entries.en: to sleep stretched out stiff, lying rigid in deep sleep
entries.notes: 西语词头“der echo”按缩损推定为 derecho，“張死”搭配罕见，故降为 medium。

entries.zh: 做梦；梦寐（西语 dormitar 打盹、soñar 做梦）
entries.en: to dream; to doze and dream

entries.zh: 睡眠；睡一遍（次字原件“遍/邊”两形存疑，据官话对音 pien 定为“遍”）
entries.en: to sleep; a bout of sleeping
entries.notes: 次字字形“遍/邊”存疑，据 R 栏 pien 与西语词头 dormir 定为“遍”，释义随之。

entries.zh: 半困半醒；似睡非睡
entries.en: half asleep and half awake; drowsing

entries.zh: 未落眠；尚未入睡、睡意未至
entries.en: to lie down but sleep has not yet come; not yet asleep

entries.zh: 寤寐；时睡时醒，打盹假寐
entries.en: to doze; waking and sleeping, slumbering lightly

entries.zh: 卧房；寝室
entries.en: bedroom; sleeping chamber

entries.zh: 二；口语所称的“两”（与下条文读之“二”相对）
entries.en: two

entries.zh: 皆；两者一并、统统都
entries.en: both; all together, the two joined

entries.zh: 更；旧时夜间计时单位，一更约两小时有余（西语谓“两小时多一点”）
entries.en: a night watch (geng), reckoned at two hours and a little more

entries.zh: 二；文读之“二”，用于依序计数（第一、第二之“二”）
entries.en: two as used in counting by order (“second”); the literary reading of “two”

entries.zh: 丑时；半夜之“二”，地支丑时约当凌晨一至三点
entries.en: the chou double-hour, the “two” of midnight (about 1-3 a.m.)

entries.zh: 未时；日中之“二”，地支未时约当下午一至三点
entries.en: the wei double-hour, the “two” of midday (about 1-3 p.m.)

entries.zh: 二起人；两类（两拨）不同的人
entries.en: two kinds of men; men of two different sorts

entries.zh: 枕边话；二人同枕之私语、枕上情话
entries.en: pillow talk; intimate words spoken lying on the same pillow
entries.notes: 首二字字形“枕/抳”“邊/遍”存疑，据 M 栏音写与西语“两颗头同一枕”定为“枕邊話”。

entries.zh: 双样色；两种颜色、花色两样
entries.en: of two colors; two different colors
entries.notes: 首字“双/雙”字形存疑，音写 siang/zoang 均与“雙”相合，语义不受影响。

entries.zh: 四体；两脚两手（四肢）
entries.en: the four limbs; two feet and two hands

entries.zh: 四肢；手脚，两脚两手
entries.en: the four limbs; hands and feet

entries.zh: 半片；一整所分之两半（一半）
entries.en: half; one of the two halves of a thing or lot
entries.notes: R 栏官话对音原件残缺，据西语释义、“半片”汉字及闽南语音写定释义，语义可定故不降至 low。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 仅西语词头“dos veces（两次）”可读，汉字、闽南语音写、官话对音三栏皆空，无从定夺词条所指。
